author: SethDGamre + Egzothicki
description: For games with the Zombies modoption. Shows a countdown over every wreck telling you exactly when it reanimates, straight from the timer the game now publishes for this purpose. White with plenty of time, purple as the rise nears, pulsing in the final seconds. The countdown reacts the moment a corpse is reclaimed or resurrected, and a purple '?' marks fogged wrecks whose timer may have changed unseen. Also shows an optional top bar panel with the zombies' current tech state: bars for how fast wrecks rise and how fast zombie labs build, with the exact numbers in Advanced mode. Display only.
